BODF.description: Self Weight (BODF). Applies a static self-weight body-force load: LCNAME selects the static load case and FV gives the self-weight scale factors in the global X, Y, Z directions.

LCNAME.description: Name of the static load case this self-weight load belongs to. Must match an existing static load case (STLD).

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the load group this self-weight load is assigned to. Empty string means no load group.

FV.description: Self-weight scale factors in the global directions [X, Y, Z]. Typically the gravity direction carries a negative factor (e.g. Z = -1). Maps to SX, SY, SZ internally.
